tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns on the account with their status and settings. Use to browse or filter campaigns; use list_campaign_reports for their performance figures.

before_create_time.description: Restrict the response to campaigns created before the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_send_time.description: Restrict the response to campaigns sent before the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

count.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation. Sent as a comma-separated list.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation. Sent as a comma-separated list.

include_resend_shortcut_eligibility.description: Return the `resend_shortcut_eligibility` field in the response, which tells you if the campaign is eligible for the various Campaign Resend Shortcuts offered.

include_resend_shortcut_usage.description: Return the `resend_shortcut_usage` field in the response.  This includes information about campaigns related by a shortcut.

list_id.description: The unique id for the list.

member_id.description: Retrieve campaigns sent to a particular list member. Member ID is The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member’s email address.

offset.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this is the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

since_create_time.description: Restrict the response to campaigns created after the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

since_send_time.description: Restrict the response to campaigns sent after the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

sort_dir.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

sort_field.description: Returns files sorted by the specified field.

tools.name: add_member_to_list
tools.title: Add member to list
tools.description: Subscribe a new email address to an audience with its merge values and status. Use only for an address the audience does not have; use add_or_update_list_member when it may already exist.

email_type.description: Type of email this member asked to get ('html' or 'text').

additionalProperties.description: Keys are interest IDs, values are booleans that describe whether the list member is in that group or not.
additionalProperties.title: Interest Value

interests.description: The key of this object's properties is the ID of the interest in question.

ip_opt.description: The IP address the subscriber used to confirm their opt-in status.

ip_signup.description: IP address the subscriber signed up from.

list_id.description: The unique ID for the list.

marketing_permissions.description: The marketing permissions for the subscriber.

items.description: A single marketing permission a subscriber has either opted-in to or opted-out of.

enabled.description: If the subscriber has opted-in to the marketing permission.

marketing_permission_id.description: The id for the marketing permission on the list

additionalProperties.description: This object's keys are merge tags (like FNAME). It's values are the values to be added to the merge field.

merge_fields.description: A dictionary of merge fields where the keys are the merge tags. See the [Merge Fields documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/merge-fields/#structure) for more about the structure.

skip_merge_validation.description: If skip_merge_validation is true, member data will be accepted without merge field values, even if the merge field is usually required. This defaults to false.

tags.description: The tags that are associated with a member.

items.description: The name of the tag that will be associated with this member.

timestamp_opt.description: The date and time the subscriber confirmed their opt-in status in ISO 8601 format.

timestamp_signup.description: The date and time the subscriber signed up for the list in ISO 8601 format.
